# zhemm

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Multiply a Hermitian diagonal matrix by the identity, using complex storage. The diagonal is unchanged.

## What this example demonstrates

Multiply a Hermitian diagonal matrix by the identity, using complex storage. The diagonal is unchanged.
